ReviewProbe.Scope: Diagonal finder geometry, all cross-checks and callers, threshold modes, arithmetic, admission and acceptance, deadlines, cancellation, pool ownership, extraction, fixture provenance and API/dependency fit

ChangedDecoders: Modern QR finder validation accepts the geometric diagonal run-count range of a rotated square finder: a diagonal step advances in both axes, so its total may be half the horizontal total. The previous upper bound, five-run ratios, horizontal/vertical cross-checks, sampling, ECC, payload checks, search limits and deadlines remain. Cross-checks use a semantic partial with unchanged axis-check method bodies. No public API or production dependency is added.
AttributionLimits: This follow-up records 191/267 correct positive images versus 188/267 in the previous pass. Previously correct images lost: none; gained: qrcode-6/13.png, qrcode-6/7.png, qrcode-6/12.png. Paired negative completion is [30, 30, 31, 30]/31 with the current binary and [30, 30, 30, 30]/31 with the previous qualified binary. All outcomes remain sensitive to shared-host contention and wall-clock budgets; no universal timeout or recognition advantage is established. The QR diagonal finder check now admits the run-count ratio of a rotated square, preserving the upper mismatch bound, all five run ratios, horizontal/vertical cross-checks and payload acceptance. Recognition budgets and search limits remain unchanged. A demonstrated regression gain does not establish accuracy on unseen photographs, and legacy fallback is unchanged. Supplemental PDF417 images are regression evidence informed by prior remediation, not an unseen holdout. The invalid GS1 AI (3922) oracle and undeclared QR character encoding policies remain unchanged in scoring. Expanded Stacked multiple-symbol localization and arbitrary perspective remain unproved; MaxiCode image scanning is unsupported.

RegressionProof.Coverage: Three unmodified independently encoded small rotated QR images through single, multi-result and scanner public APIs, using the original 1500 ms recognition allowance and independent clean warmup. Existing photograph, artwork, rotation, multi-symbol, parity and nested-budget contracts remain covered. Legacy decoding is unchanged.
RegressionProof.HistoricalProof: Earlier QR photograph, Data Matrix and PDF417 proof remains historical in previous-qualification.json. Current full suites and frozen/supplemental outcomes are rerun.

TestExecution.Net472: Task-local runner configuration disables collection parallelism; recognition allowances and assertions are unchanged.
TestExecution.Limit: Short wall-clock allowances remain sensitive to shared-host load. Serial legacy qualification is not proof for default parallel execution.

SupplementalPdf417.Limit: Supplemental images from the same upstream collection, outside the 18 frozen comparison images. Wall-clock budgets also limit attribution of changed outcomes.
